name: DBeaver PRO
title: dbeaver.com
shortDescription: DBeaver PRO is a professional data management software designed for technical and business users who need to handle SQL, NoSQL, and cloud data sources. It offers a professional SQL Editor and a suite of tools for database administration, making it suitable for tasks like financial analysis, software development, and data collaboration across teams.
